notes.title: Polished Japanese and English Localizations Now Available!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We're excited to announce that polished Japanese and English localizations are now live! In addition to these improvements, we've also addressed a number of bugs.

If you haven't had a chance to play Sunset Hills yet, don't forget that we also released a major update on April 10th!

Here's a quick recap of what was included in that previous update:
[list]
[*]Chapter 1 Ending Expansion:
We listened to your feedback and have added some content to the ending of Chapter 1, hoping to address the slight sense of incompleteness some of you felt.
[*]Official Wallpaper Pack Now Available:
Decorate your desktop with the beautiful scenery of Sunset Hills!
[*]Official Soundtrack Now Available:
Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of Sunset Hills anytime, anywhere!
[/list]

You can get all of this by updating your game on Steam now. We'll be sharing news about the upcoming chapters later, so be sure to stay tuned!

notes.title: FREE Update, OST, Wallpaper Pack, More!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, long time no see!

First off, a HUGE thank you from the bottom of our hearts for all the love and support you've shown Sunset Hills! It's your passion that keeps us going. ːSpeech_Loveː

We've been listening closely to all your feedback since launch – the cheers, the suggestions, and even the constructive criticism – and we're ready to show our appreciation. We've been hard at work crafting more of the Sunset Hills story and experience you've been craving... ːsteamthumbsupː

We've got BIG plans for Sunset Hills, including future chapters, more localizations, enhanced Steam features, Steam Deck support, a Nintendo Switch release, and even a mobile launch! ːGhostFlowerHappyː

[b][h1]Free Content Update Incoming![/h1][/b]

Get ready! We're dropping a [b]FREE update[/b] for the Steam version of Sunset Hills in [b]early April[/b]!

This update includes story content to address some of those plot points you felt were missing, along with some quality-of-life improvements to make your gameplay even smoother. 

PLUS, we're officially launching a [b]FREE mini-soundtrack[/b] and a [b]FREE wallpaper pack[/b]! We think these additions will seriously enhance your Sunset Hills experience.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3399560
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3174350

[b][h1]Mobile Launch Coming Soon![/h1][/b]

This summer, we're bringing Sunset Hills to [b]mobile[/b]! Get ready to experience the story on both [b]Android and iOS[/b] devices.

If you're hyped for mobile, hit those pre-register links below and follow our official channels to be among the first to play!

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1523616156

Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.cottongame.sunsethills


Our goal is to support and update the game for a long time, and we're listening all your valuable feedback.

We've taken everything you've said to heart. Less talk, more action – we're committed to proving it! ːmlrem3ː

Stay tuned for even MORE good news in the coming weeks. Thanks for being such an awesome community! Nico's with you all! ːtobdogː

notes.title: The first wave of updates for Sunset Hill is here! With a surprise discount~
notes.content:
Dear beloved players:

We are thrilled to announce that "Sunset Hills" has live at TGS2024. Visit us at Hall 9, Indie Games Section, Booth 09-W62 to experience the magic firsthand. 

Don't be disheartened if you can't make it in person; we've prepared a historical low discount for Sunset Hills! Invite your good friends to enjoy this weekend to the fullest!ːSpeech_Loveː

Our team is dedicated to refining and expanding the game. This update marks the first wave of improvements, with more to follow alongside the Japanese release. Stay tuned for more updates!

[h1]Bugs Fixes Update[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed incorrect grey dot display on options.
[*] Resolved movement issue in the orphanage.
[*] Fixed the issue with accepting Ferruccio's costume quest.
[*] Adjusted spin wheel settings for long-press rotation.
[*] Addressed positioning problems in bookstore dialogues.
[*] Corrected overlapping item shadows.
[*] Fixed animation errors when placing items in the backpack.
[*] Corrected avatar display issues at the observation deck.
[*] Fixed camera glitch transitioning from the main menu to the commercial street.
[/list]
[h1]Gameplay Content Update[/h1]
[list]
[*] Map bubbles at the bus stop will remain visible until collected.
[*] Set Ferruccio's family TV to retain channels, allowing players to customize their experience with synchronized music and animation.
[*] Removed borderless mode from the main menu.
[/list]
These updates are now live, so we invite both new and returning players to explore the changes. Enjoy a relaxing gaming journey with us and remember, Nico stands by your side!ːtobdogː

We value the feedback received since launch and have held numerous internal meetings to address player concerns. Your insights drive us to continuously improve, ensuring we offer the ultimate experience for all dog lovers. We are listening and learning from you.

Rest assured, we are committed to enhancing the game while staying true to our vision. Our team is working tirelessly to polish upcoming chapters and optimize the gaming experience. We kindly ask for your continued support and trust. Your feedback is crucial to our growth, and we are grateful for your patience and constructive criticism. Together, we will create even more amazing adventures.

Thank you for your unwavering support!ːSpeech_Loveː

notes.title: Update for Sunset Hills Japanese Support
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550174/03b7f90ca91bfce9d4a9504661070f902a16df92.jpg[/img]
It's great news that Sunset Hills is coming to Steam on October 3, 2024 in Japanese! Thank you for your patience. We will also be attending the Tokyo Game Show (TGS) from September 26 to September 29, 2024, so please come visit us at booth 09-W62 in the Hall9 Indie Games section.

The Japanese localization of Sunset Hills has already been completed for a while, and both the Cotton Game and Asmik Ace teams wish to offer the best localization quality we can,  which will take 2-3 months for the internal testing & beta testing then make some optimizations before we release the Japanese version. We hope with the game release, we can have more players who speak English and Japanese join our localization testing and give us valuable feedback.

We look forward to seeing you all at the show!

By : Cotton Game & Asmik Ace, Inc. (Japan)
2024/8/13
